justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/auxiliary/TypeProxy.java, byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/auxiliary/TypeProxyInvocationFactoryDefaultTest.java, and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/auxiliary/TypeProxyCreationTest.java. The interface is a small inner strategy with one method and one nested enum implementation (SUPER_METHOD, DEFAULT_METHOD); in the production code it is only used inside TypeProxy itself at three call sites, and the only external references are two tests. This shows low fan-in and low fan-out, not a dependency hub.
